title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 026
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute rewind square and forward variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number five inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer inside a rounded square frame marked five.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the circular rewind family when the square frame is the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a rounded square frame around the rewind timer and shows the number five.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number ten inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the square framed rewind timer labeled ten.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the other square rewind counts when the number ten is the key cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the rounded square rewind frame and changes the center number to ten.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number fifteen inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the square rewind timer variant labeled fifteen.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the five ten or thirty square timers when fifteen is the visible number.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot matches the square rewind family and places the number fifteen inside the frame.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number thirty inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the largest count version in the square rewind family.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lower square rewind counts when the number thirty should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the framed rewind shape and changes only the center number to thirty.

items.depicts_observation: Right hooked return arrow with a straight lower line and rounded outer bend
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain forward or return arrow instead of a rewind timer.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for square countdown rewind icons when the icon should stay as one simple arrow.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a plain hooked arrow pointing right without any frame or number.
